image_description: Two baby bibs lying flat on a textured beige fabric surface. The top bib is light mint green with a rounded neck opening, featuring three small square patch pockets with plaid patterns and button details. The bottom bib is larger, made of multi-colored plaid fabric (red, green, yellow, blue) with white lace trim along the edges. Both appear to be made of soft fabric.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The small plaid patches on the green bib have slightly inconsistent scale and alignment compared to the main plaid bib underneath, though this could be intentional design. The stitching around the pockets looks slightly soft/melted upon close inspection.

The pinkish trim around the neck of the green bib appears to merge slightly with the mint green fabric without clear stitching definition, looking somewhat like painted-on texture rather than sewn fabric.
